description: Fetch an Instagram profile: account metadata (username, display name, bio, external link, avatar, post/follower/following counts, verification, private flag) plus a media grid from one of its tabs — posts (default), reels, reposts, or tagged. Mirrors the tabs on instagram.com/{user}/ and its /reels/, /reposts/, /tagged/ sub-paths. The grid lazy-loads internally up to 100 items; partial=true when the tab is exhausted. Follower/following full lists are NOT included (Instagram restricts them to the account owner). Requires a logged-in Instagram session.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username as it appears in the profile URL: instagram.com/{user}/ (e.g. "shopify"). Discovery: click any author avatar/name, or use instagram/search --type accounts.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Profile content tab: posts (default, the main grid) | reels (short videos) | reposts (reposted content) | tagged (posts this account is tagged in). Mirrors the tabs on the profile page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of grid items to return (1-100, default 20). Scrolls internally; partial=true when the grid is exhausted.
